name: count
title: player:count
lead: Returns how many of an item the player carries, across every slot.

usedIn.quote: player:count("iron_ingot")  -- how many of one item, across every slot; see "items of your own" for what matches
player:count({ id = "copper_ingot" })    -- every copper ingot they carry
player:count("brick")                    -- plain bricks only, never a copper ingot
